programmes.d: Amy and Colin share their first kiss since his surgery. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown hesitantly agrees to attend a party for single people with the recently divorced Reverend Thomas Keyes.
When a traveling psychologist comes back to town, Dr. Brown realizes how attracted to her he is. Meanwhile, Edna and Irv have difficulty adjusting to life after a heart attack scare.
Dr. Abbott and Dr. Brown join a murder investigation to find out what really happened and clear the reputations of two men. Meanwhile, Ephram can't seem to stop thinking about Amy.
Ephram confronts a repressed memory of his father cheating on his mother. Meanwhile, Amy worries about Colin's recovery when he becomes violently ill on a date.
Although Amy and Bright are still in denial regarding Colin's recovery, Ephram can't ignore the negative signs. Meanwhile, a New York magazine reporter visits Dr. Brown.
Ephram feels the pressure of performing his first piano recital in Everwood. Dr. Brown and Dr. Abbott attempt to diagnose a man with a mysterious sleeping disorder.
Ephram returns to New York and reconnects with his old life, while Andy faces emotional challenges back in Everwood as past and present begin to collide.
After Colin has a seizure, Dr. Brown strongly advises Colin's father, James, to allow him to perform brain surgery on Colin. But Colin's parents resist the dangerous procedure.
As the day of Colin's surgery approaches, Dr. Brown consults with his accomplished mentor. Meanwhile, Colin takes Amy and Bright on an adventure on his last day before the operation.
The townspeople cope with their grief over Colin Hart's death last spring, and Dr. Brown and his family are unfairly marked as social outcasts because he was unable to save Colin.
Dr. Brown is concerned that Ephram needs more extracurricular activities to be accepted at a top college. Amy's lack of interest in college preparation alarms her mother more than her father.
Dr. Abbott's sister Linda returns and encounters major resistance when she announces her decision to join his practice. Meanwhile, Bright asks Ephram to watch over Amy.
Dr. Brown's plan to give Ephram more free time by hiring college student Madison as a caretaker for Delia makes things worse. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown is distracted from helping Nina.
When Dr. Brown invites Linda to the Brown house to discuss a patient, Delia lashes out. With some insight from Madison, Ephram figures out the reason for his sister's bad behavior.
Much to his chagrin, Dr. Abbott suspects that Linda and Dr. Brown are far too attracted to each other, so he decides to select more appropriate suitors for his sister.
When a coal mine collapses, Dr. Brown rushes to the scene, along with Edna, Linda and Dr. Abbott. Dr. Brown must confront his biggest fears in order to save lives.
When a mechanic correctly "diagnoses" Dr. Brown's young patient, the townspeople believe he is a seer. Meanwhile, Ephram confronts Madison about his feelings for her.
Dr. Brown courts Linda, despite Edna and Dr. Abbott's insistence that he's wasting his time. Meanwhile, Bright tells Ephram to ignore Madison in order to win her affections.

Juliette finds the Movement is not what she thought. Tension in the band causes Alannah to leave and sign with Shiny New Records. Twig develops feelings for Maddie, but she shuts him down.
The past comes visiting Deacon. The band flounders without Alannah and considers quitting. Brad puts inappropriate moves on Alannah, who tells Avery. Sean's wife becomes jealous of Scarlett.
Scarlett tries to help Sean, but he doubts her motives. Deacon deals with forgiveness and a new family dynamic. Feeling out of depth on Nashville's Next, Daphne finds help in Judge De Witt.
Deacon and the girls grow worried when Gideon starts leaving the house. Juliette confronts Darius. Twig tries to keep Jonah's secret from Maddie. Brad's behavior is not limited to Alannah.
A medical scare gets Avery and Juliette talking. Scarlett and Sean organize a ranch benefit. Gunnar gets inspired. Avery questions a relationship. Maddie tests Twig. Deacon learns a secret.
Deacon gets a chance to fulfill a lifelong dream. Juliette makes a crucial decision. Daphne preps for the final round. Alannah confronts Brad. Avery, Gunnar, and Will discuss their future.

Rayna is upset when her record company asks her to tour as the opening act for a popular newcomer; Rayna's father, Lamar, disregards her wishes when he backs her husband in a run for mayor of Nashville.
